note: 2.0.136 fix: friend row clicks now go through our own guarded point click - focus WeChat, verify the window under the cursor really is that WeChat window (plus the click fence inside the friends list) and only then send the mouse event; node.Click() clicked blindly and on the user's machine one click even landed on a Chrome window while row clicks were swallowed in a loop (card_not_confirmed + pane_not_showing_target, then reopen group, over and over). Includes 2.0.135: the contacts list is picked by scoring which candidate has its own rows inside its own rect, and a mismatch aborts with contacts_list_mismatch instead of clicking.
